propositions: BindingStore embeds multiple lifecycle concerns (forward/reverse transitions, pending/confirmed state, numeric-ID re-key, comment identity, absence grace, tombstones, unretire policy) that must be extracted into a cohesive private policy owner
Production rich-text convergence mutates inner dictionaries through shallow all_bindings() without policy enforcement; a narrow named operation must become the supported mutation seam
Lifecycle policy owner must preserve at-most-one identity invariant through targeted reverse-entry cleanup and never refuse or abort on ambiguous double-binds (existing behavior)
Facade must retain all existing method signatures and all_bindings() semantics while delegating lifecycle operations to the policy owner and denying direct repository mutation access to callers
Comment identity, numeric-ID re-keys, tombstone suppression, retirement on triple 404, absence reset on successful read, and all current failure modes must be preserved exactly as-is
The narrow rich-emission operation (note_rich_emit) must match current hash/counter/save behavior while missing bindings remain nonfatal
